Adding a few clarifying points so Acme has what you need for SIG fields A3/A4:

- Control plane (management) is logically separated from data plane: control plane endpoints are in a dedicated management VPC with tightly scoped egress to our telemetry endpoints and the customer's chosen KMS. Mutual TLS and client certs are used for control plane connections.
- Data plane for Dedicated: customer workloads run in customer-dedicated subnets on customer-tagged instances. East-west access is restricted via host-level microsegmentation (ipset + nftables) and enforced by our agent; default deny for all inbound except established sessions and required model serving ports.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): we provide a control-plane connector running in the customer's network; the service uses ephemeral TLS tunnels outbound; no inbound management ports are opened to the public internet.

I'll attach the raw rule exports we use for audits — these are sanitized (no customer IPs) and map to the SIG rule fields. Mina: can you attach the subnet_mappings and fw export in the next reply?

-Karthik
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
